Senator Unveils Bill to Force More Disclosure of Deaths in ICE Custody

As Democrats prepare to take control of Congress next year, Sen. Andy Kim of New Jersey on Thursday unveiled new legislation aimed at addressing the surge in deaths of people in immigration detention centers . The Death in Detention Transparency Act put forward by Kim would beef up what Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) is required to tell Congress when a detainee dies in a detention center, hospital, or while being transported.
